title: Sphere on an incline: rolls with a = 5/7 g sin, slides with a = g (sin - mu_d cos) and spin 5 mu_d g cos / 2r; the regime flips at tan(theta_c) = 3.5 mu_s

tol.derivation: distance along the slope against the scheme's s_n = a t_n (t_n + h) / 2 (velocity is the half-step difference): rounding over the run, plus g h^2 for the first substep settling into the plane and a t h for the substep in which the motion starts; spin: 2 alpha h + 32u; rolling: contact point speed <= 2 g h
tol.source: rigid-body dynamics of a rolling and of a sliding sphere; Coulomb friction
